approved_findings: Same canonical URL and same card/LPM decline-code reference, with Stripe decline codes distinct from issuer codes and optional advice_code guidance (old lines 4-16; new lines 5-17). The 50 card table rows remain 50. Most card changes are wording or formatting, but processing_error next-step guidance changes materially: old line 56 says retry then try again later, while new line 57 says retry then contact the issuer if still unprocessed.

The LPM table grows from 19 rows with 19 distinct decline codes (old lines 77-95) to 29 rows with 27 distinct decline codes (new lines 78-106). Three Klarna outcome rows share one decline code, klarna_payment_declined (new lines 78-80), so the source should not describe 29 distinct codes. Eight distinct decline-code names are added: klarna_payment_declined, customer_declined, code_invalid, code_expired, partner_action_not_supported, lost_or_stolen_card, card_already_activated, invalid_track_data. No old LPM code is removed.

Klarna additions distinguish a declined payment, user-canceled checkout, and expired checkout through charge outcome reason while sharing klarna_payment_declined (new lines 78-80). BLIK code_invalid and code_expired map to generic_decline outcome, and code_expired's API message says BLIK codes expire after two minutes and asks for another code (new lines 83-84). Do not collapse decline code, charge outcome reason, seller message, and API error message into one field.

Additional LPM rows carry consequential actions: partner_action_not_supported and card_already_activated say retries will not succeed (new lines 103, 105); lost_or_stolen_card says hide the specific reason from customers and present partner_generic_decline (new line 104); invalid_track_data directs checking with the issuer (new line 106). Keep these actions scoped to the particular table rows and payment methods.

Current source lines 13, 51-75 claim 19 LPM codes and list only the old rows; update that coverage and preserve the May count as dated. Concept wiki/concepts/stripe-declines.md line 150 also says 19 total and 'not on cards'; the latter is overbroad because expired_card, processing_error, insufficient_funds, currency_not_supported, invalid_amount, and duplicate_transaction occur in both card and LPM tables (old lines 30, 38, 40, 56, 26, 29, 81-85, 94; new lines 27, 31, 39, 41, 57, 88-92, 101).

Current source line 45 narrows testmode_decline to a test card used in live mode, while both raws only say a Stripe test card number was used and a genuine card must be used (old line 65; new line 66). Current source line 48 says deprecated do_not_try_again and try_again_later are now advice_code values; both raws mark them deprecated in the decline-code table, but do not establish the asserted migration of those exact values to advice_code (old lines 28, 67; new lines 29, 68). Avoid the unsupported expansions when updating.
approved_conflicts: May old card processing_error next step says try again later after a failed retry; November new line 57 directs contacting the issuer if still unprocessed. Cite the capture date when giving next-step guidance.

historical_claims_to_preserve: Keep the May capture's 19-row/19-distinct-name LPM table as dated history, and the November table's 29 rows/27 names as the newer captured reference (old lines 75-95; new lines 76-106).

Retain the 50 card rows, masking of fraudulent/lost_card/stolen_card/merchant_blacklist as generic_decline, and deprecated labels for do_not_try_again and try_again_later (old lines 18-69; new lines 19-70).

Retain card authentication_required's usually automatic Stripe-front-end soft-decline auth flow with off-session qualification, and authentication_not_handled's need for 3DS/SCA with on-session preparation (old lines 20-21; new lines 21-22).

unresolved_questions: The reference table does not prove which of the listed LPM codes is emitted by a specific payment provider or account; table presence is not a guarantee of runtime occurrence.
The captures label do_not_try_again and try_again_later deprecated but do not specify from this page alone whether their exact names now appear as advice_code values.
The captures do not establish that testmode_decline necessarily means a test card was used in live mode.
